Rules

Match the top card's active color, number, action, or creature artwork. Draw one card if needed; only that drawn card may be played immediately. Draw Two and Wild Draw Four force the next player to draw and lose a turn. House rule: +2 and +4 can stack on either draw card; if you cannot stack, draw the entire accumulated penalty and lose your turn. Wild Draw Four is legal only when you have no card of the active color. Reverse changes direction; in a two-player game it skips the rival. Say FATHÉRMON UN before playing your second-to-last card. Players who empty their hands finish and leave the round. Play continues until only one player remains; first to finish wins, last remaining places last.

Dojo Challenge = Skip; Soul Reversal = Reverse; Evolution Burst = Draw Two; V-Zorb Capture = Wild; Spirit Surge = Wild Draw Four. These are themed names for the standard 108-card deck.
